name: deployer-checkup
description: Open Atlas Deployer's scheduled check-up of the managed NiFi services: reads their lights and data through the Deployer's MCP verbs, and writes the analysis and to-dos back (the registered businesses only; it does not build the business model).

credential_requirements.description: The Deployer's check-up key (dpc_), stored for the MCP URL above: reads, writes analyses and to-dos; never drafts a change and never writes the business model.
